title: 별빛 사막 유적
description: 별이 쏟아지는 사막의 고대 관측 유적에서 다섯 가지 차이를 찾아보세요.
scene: A whimsical ancient desert astronomy ruin at blue hour, with a sandstone arch observatory, a large brass astrolabe, a small domed telescope, patterned rugs without letters, ceramic water jars, a turquoise treasure chest, date palms, glowing lanterns, a friendly fennec fox, distant pyramidal rock formations, and a star-filled violet sky
style: premium whimsical storybook illustration, warm amber sandstone balanced with turquoise and deep violet accents, crisp object silhouettes, richly detailed but uncluttered, gentle cinematic lighting
changeGuidance: Spread changes across the upper arch and sky, central astrolabe, left-side jars and rug, right-side telescope and chest, and the foreground fox; avoid global sky, lighting, or sand changes
